verdict.rationale: Bland's first-party docs state it supports inbound and outbound SIP, so you can point calls from your own carrier or PBX at Bland or place calls out through your SIP provider. It also lets you connect your own Twilio account to bring existing numbers, and offers number porting. That clearly avoids lock-in to bundled telephony. Missing for 10: any Telnyx-specific number import evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SIP setup, and clarity on whether SIP trunking is limited to enterprise plans (it is documented under enterprise-features).

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Bland supports inbound and outbound SIP. Point calls from your carrier or PBX at Bland to be answered by an agent, or have Bland place calls out through your SIP provider.
Users can connect their own Twilio account to Bland, easily bring over your existing phone numbers to use within the platform.
Number porting to bring existing numbers to Bland
